stem: Which factor encouraged more immigrants to settle in northern states than southern states during the mid-nineteenth century?

options.label: A
options.text: Northern states had lower population densities.

options.label: B
options.text: Citizenship requirements in southern states were not as strict.

options.label: C
options.text: Southern states had smaller industrial sectors.

options.label: D
options.text: Governments in northern states were less corrupt.
